headline: Planning Board to discuss Old Tower Hill Road Neighborhood Project form-based code and a possible road/farm stand ordinance.
summary: The Planning Board will follow up on the Old Tower Hill Road Neighborhood Project form-based code and discuss a possible draft ordinance on road and farm stands. The board will also review reports on the Rt. 1 Stewardship Plan and the Harbor Management Plan.
items: Follow up on Old Tower Hill Road Neighborhood Project, Form-Based Code, from recent Town Council meetings
General discussion on Road/Farm Stands for a possible draft ordinance
Rt. 1 Stewardship Plan presented for Planning Board information
Harbor Management Plan presented for Planning Board information
location: Town Council Chambers, South Kingstown Town Hall, 180 High Street, Wakefield, RI 02879
